title: Our Right to Health: Needs, Resources and Society
description: An overview of health law with a focus on EU health law (economic freedoms, non-discrimination, human rights, values and ethics) and a comparison of Beveridge and Bismarck health systems.
assessment: On-site written exam with multiple-choice and essay questions, for attending and non-attending students. No AI during the exam.
textbooks: Frischhut, M. (2026). What one should know about the European Union (EU): A quick introduction to EU law (5th ed.). NWV.
Greer, S. L. et al. (2024). Everything you always wanted to know about European Union health policy but were afraid to ask (4th ed.).
